claim: Failed rowid/PK lookups are never cached, so every GetStream call on an unresolvable blob column re-runs the full column scan (and for INTEGER-PK candidates re-executes the pragma_table_info query) — a repeated-work regression vs the removed sentinel caching.
raw: The new code only calls `RowIds.Add` on success; when the loop completes without a match (WITHOUT ROWID tables, expression/aggregate blob columns, composite-PK tables), nothing is added to `RowIds`, so the next `GetStream` call for that same ordinal repeats the entire `FieldCount` scan
